subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Turkish Tea: Çay
description: A short lesson to help you apply Turkish Tea: Çay.

hook.text: Turkey drinks more tea per capita than any country on Earth—over 3 kg per person annually, beating even Britain.

buildup.text: Turkish çay is brewed in a stacked double teapot called a çaydanlık. Water boils below; strong tea steeps above.

discovery.text: It's served in small tulip-shaped glasses with sugar but never milk. The glass shape shows the tea's ruby-red color.

twist.text: Turkey only started growing tea in 1939, replacing coffee. Now the Black Sea coast produces 280,000 tons annually.

climax.text: Çay is served at every meeting, every shop, and every negotiation. Refusing it stops business before it starts.

punchline.text: Red, sweet, tulip-shaped, non-negotiable. Turkey runs on çay.

quiz.question: Which country consumes the most tea per capita?
